title: Cylinder wave — two prescribed views
prompt:
Create 1000 equally spaced t values from 0 through 2π, including endpoints. Use x=r cos(t), y=r sin(t), z=h cos(a t), with r=1 in, h=0.3 in and a=10.
Plot the same curve in navy in both panels. Left: elevation 35°, azimuth −130°. Right: elevation 65°, azimuth −130°.
Use NumPy and Matplotlib. Create one figure with two side-by-side panels; include the specified plot in BOTH panels. Give each panel a title and x/y labels with inches; 3D line plots also need z [in], while scalar-field plots use the dimensionless label z. Add a grid on 3D line plots. Call fig.tight_layout(), save the whole figure as HW4_practice_Q01.png (dpi=150), and display it with plt.show().
given: 完整编程变式，依据老师 HW4 第 1 类程序。t 是弧度；view_init 的视角是度。
starter:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Write the complete program here.
notes: 单一参数 t 对应一串 (x,y,z)，不使用 meshgrid。fig.add_subplot(1,2,1,projection="3d") 创建左图；ax.plot(x,y,z) 画空间曲线。view_init(elev=...,azim=...) 的参数单位是度。
hint: 先算三个同长度的一维坐标数组，再创建两个3D坐标轴；在两图画同一组坐标，只改变视角。
check: 三个坐标数组长度1000；起终点均约(1,0,0.3)；x²+y²≈1。两幅曲线相同，视角不同。
solution:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

t = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 1000)
r, h, a = 1, 0.3, 10
x = r*np.cos(t)
y = r*np.sin(t)
z = h*np.cos(a*t)
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(11, 5))
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(1, 2, 1, projection="3d")
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(1, 2, 2, projection="3d")

for ax, elev, azim, title in ((ax1, 35, -130, "View 1"), (ax2, 65, -130, "View 2")):
    ax.plot(x, y, z, color="navy", linewidth=2)
    ax.view_init(elev=elev, azim=azim)
    ax.set(xlabel="x [in]", ylabel="y [in]", zlabel="z [in]", title=title)
    ax.grid(True)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("HW4_practice_Q01.png", dpi=150)
plt.show()

# Write the complete program here.
notes: meshgrid(xv,yv) 的形状是 (len(yv),len(xv))：X 每行复制 xv，Y 每列复制 yv。contour 画线；contourf 填色；这两图使用普通2D坐标轴。把返回对象传给 fig.colorbar(p,ax=ax)。明确 levels 数组可以固定等高值；整数 levels 是自动选层的目标数量，未必恰好等于线条数。
hint: np.hypot(X,Y) 等价于 np.sqrt(X**2+Y**2)。先生成网格并计算 Z，再画图；两个色条分别绑定各自的返回对象。
check: X、Y、Z均为(121,121)；Z在中心为0，Z[60,70]≈sin(1)=0.841471；两幅图应为同心的环形等高结构。
solution:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

xv = np.linspace(-6, 6, 121)
yv = np.linspace(-6, 6, 121)
X, Y = np.meshgrid(xv, yv)
Z = np.sin(np.hypot(X, Y))
levels = np.linspace(-1, 1, 21)
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 5))

p1 = ax1.contour(X, Y, Z, levels=levels, cmap="jet")
p2 = ax2.contourf(X, Y, Z, levels=levels, cmap="jet")
fig.colorbar(p1, ax=ax1, label="z")
fig.colorbar(p2, ax=ax2, label="z")
for ax, title in ((ax1, "Contours"), (ax2, "Filled contours")):
    ax.set(xlabel="x [in]", ylabel="y [in]", title=title)
    ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box")
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("HW4_practice_Q04.png", dpi=150)
plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

yv = np.linspace(-6, 6, 121)

Z = np.sin(np.hypot(X, Y))
levels = np.linspace(-1, 1, 21)
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(11, 5))

ax2 = fig.add_subplot(1, 2, 2, projection="3d")

p2 = ax2.plot_surface(X, Y, Z, cmap="jet", rstride=1, cstride=1, linewidth=0)

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Write the complete program here.
notes: ax.plot_surface(X,Y,Z,cmap="jet") 绘制彩色曲面。先画曲面，再用 ax.contour(X,Y,Z,levels=...,zdir="z",offset=...) 将等高线投影到固定 z 平面。offset 应低于曲面最小高度，并用 set_zlim 包含它；每个色条绑定对应的 surface 返回对象。

solution:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

xv = np.linspace(-5, 5, 101)
yv = np.linspace(-5, 5, 101)
X, Y = np.meshgrid(xv, yv)
Z = 2*np.sin(np.hypot(X, Y))
print(f"{Z[50, 60]:.6f}")
levels = np.linspace(-2, 2, 21)
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(11, 5))
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(1, 2, 1, projection="3d")
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(1, 2, 2, projection="3d")

p1 = ax1.plot_surface(X, Y, Z, cmap="jet", rstride=1, cstride=1, linewidth=0)
p2 = ax2.plot_surface(X, Y, Z, cmap="jet", rstride=1, cstride=1, linewidth=0)
ax2.contour(X, Y, Z, levels=levels, zdir="z", offset=-2.5, cmap="jet")
fig.colorbar(p1, ax=ax1, label="z")
fig.colorbar(p2, ax=ax2, label="z")
for ax, title in ((ax1, "Surface"), (ax2, "Surface + projected contours")):
    ax.set(xlabel="x [in]", ylabel="y [in]", zlabel="z", title=title)
    ax.view_init(elev=45, azim=-120)
ax2.set_zlim(-2.5, 2)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("HW4_practice_Q10.png", dpi=150)
plt.show()
